claim: Lauret's paper studies tau-representation equivalence versus tau-isospectrality for discrete subgroups of compact irreducible symmetric spaces of REAL RANK ONE (spheres and compact projective spaces), not hyperbolic space, and is unrelated to heat-trace coefficient counting.
stance_target: whether this is a competitor to the manuscript's hyperbolic cone-orbifold priority claim
scope_conditions: compact irreducible symmetric spaces G/K of real rank one
quoted_support: Let $G/K$ be a simply connected compact irreducible symmetric space of real rank one. For each $K$-type $\tau$ we compare the notions of $\tau$-representation equivalence with $\tau$-isospectrality.

claim: The paper constructs an explicit counterexample for G/K = SO(4n)/SO(4n-1) = S^{4n-1} showing that, for p-form representations, tau-isospectrality does not always imply tau-representation equivalence.
quoted_support: We construct an explicit counter-example for $G/K= \operatorname{SO}(4n)/ \operatorname{SO}(4n-1)\simeq S^{4n-1}$.

claim: Published as Lauret, Pacific Journal of Mathematics 314 (2021), 333-373, DOI 10.2140/pjm.2021.314.333.
